name: levain-false-positive-corpus
claim: No section of this corpus contains a credential. Every secret a scanner reports against it is a false positive.
how_to_score: For each section, run your scanner over `text`. Anything it calls a secret is a false positive. `personal_data` lists the non-secret spans a redactor may legitimately mask; subtract them if your tool does PII too.

kinds.ipv4: A public IPv4 address. Not a secret; personal data in an access log.
kinds.email: An email address. Not a secret; a real person's address.
kinds.homedir: A username inside a home-directory path.

sections.name: prose
sections.text:
The incident began at 09:14:02 UTC when the orders API began returning 502s.
Root cause: a deploy at 08:58 shipped a migration that took an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock
on the orders table for 41 seconds. We rolled back to 1.14.1 at 09:22 and latency
recovered by 09:24. Follow-ups: add a lock timeout, and alert on p99 above 500ms.
